# `array_append`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Add the element at the end of the array passed as first
argument. Type of element should be similar to type of the elements of the array.
Null element is also appended into the array. But if the array passed, is NULL
output is NULL

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
array_append(array, element)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array_append, example 1
> SELECT array_append(array('b', 'd', 'c', 'a'), 'd');
["b","d","c","a","d"]
```

```sql
-- array_append, example 2
> SELECT array_append(array(1, 2, 3, null), null);
[1,2,3,null,null]
```

```sql
-- array_append, example 3
> SELECT array_append(CAST(null as Array<Int>), 2);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.4.0.
